visual_philosophy: Create a quiet tactile editorial field where expressive handmade title geometry, a restrained object/raw-material still life, active whitespace and low-volume metadata share one optical rhythm. Soft materiality, muted tonal relationships and carefully controlled density create calm authorship rather than promotional loudness.

stable_grammar.statement: Non-uniform character scale and placement form an asymmetric expressive title field balanced by quieter side information; the title behaves as a spatial object rather than a horizontal text line.
Active whitespace carries separation, tension, reading order and density control among title, still life and metadata.
A low tactile object/raw-material still-life anchor carries physical presence without becoming a conventional centered finished-product hero.
Secondary labels and tertiary prose establish a quiet editorial cadence around the primary title-object field.
Echoed verticals and diagonals, silhouette counterbalance, title-stroke direction, object axes and metadata alignment form one cross-element optical geometry.
Handmade ink/brush-like display behavior uses stroke variation, irregular character mass, controlled imperfect edges and non-uniform spacing/scale compositionally without copying exact glyphs.
Warm mineral matte fields, muted earthy tonal relations, soft diffuse light, restrained speculars and gentle shadow separation create tactile calm rather than glossy promotion.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Use semantically grounded vessels, raw materials, tools, packaging, craft objects or restrained finished products.
variation_axes.guardrail: Maintain low tactile anchoring and avoid a conventional centered product hero.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Use original wording and original glyph forms.
variation_axes.guardrail: Preserve behavior-level handmade irregularity, asymmetric mass and spatial integration; do not copy source glyphs.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Exact off-white, olive, ink and charcoal values may change.
variation_axes.guardrail: Preserve matte-mineral, muted, low-saturation and soft-light role relationships.

variation_axes.allowed_change: Metadata count, axes and placement may change.
variation_axes.guardrail: Retain meaningful secondary/tertiary cadence and active whitespace.

content_compatibility.requirement: A quiet, semantically grounded tactile object/raw-material anchor is available; a literal vessel is not required.
Meaningful copy hierarchy can create editorial cadence and active whitespace remains structurally available.

content_compatibility.risk: A conventional centered finished-product hero is high-risk, but a finished product may work when treated as a restrained still-life object.

features: exact side-label wording and identity elements

typography_role.display: Expressive organic handmade behavior with variable stroke, mass, edge, spacing and scale; the title is a spatial object.
typography_role.functional: Low-volume labels and prose provide quiet editorial cadence and align with the same geometry.

typography_program.copy_fidelity_policy: VERBATIM_REQUIRED for all locked brand, product, price, date, address, slogan, English-name and functional copy; new naming/translation/display content requires human approval.
transfer_risks: brand-bound glyph or side-rail copy leakage

color_light_material_signature.freedom: Broader matte-mineral material relationship may transfer without copying the original paper.

integration_rules.rule: Title-stroke direction, object axes, silhouette counterbalance and metadata alignment must form one cross-element geometry.
Whitespace remains active structure around the title, tactile anchor and editorial information.
Photography/materiality remains quiet and tactile; it cannot become a glossy promotional product layer under pasted typography.

generic_shortcut_blockers: Do not collapse to beige background plus giant brush title plus centered plated dish.
Do not copy exact source glyphs, object inventory, four-label count or paper grain.
Do not replace active whitespace and editorial cadence with generic minimalist emptiness.
